about_the_game:
NOMAD calls you into a vast, open world shaped by the Silk Road era’s cultural crossroads, nomadic traditions, and mythical folklore. As a wandering survivor, forge your own destiny; hunt, trade, form alliances or rivalries, and face both natural and supernatural threats.Pack your camp, migrate across ever-changing lands, and build a legendary nomadic legacy in a world where survival must be earned. 

The Heart of Nomadic Life: Horses

In nomadic culture, the horse is not just an animal. It is survival.

Your clan’s strength depends entirely on its herd. Establish a dedicated horse ranch, breed diverse horse types suited for different terrains and climates, and raise them with care. Endurance, speed, strength, and temperament all matter. The right horse can determine whether your people endure the winter or fall behind.

Migration defines your existence.

As seasons change, you must dismantle your tents, load your belongings, and move toward safer lands. Harness 2, 3, or 4 horses to a single wagon to transport your tents and supplies. The number and quality of horses directly affect mobility, cargo capacity, and travel efficiency.

You travel on horseback.
You fight on horseback.
You migrate because of horses.

Without horses, there is no movement. Without movement, there is no survival.

In this world, the horse is not a side feature. It is the core of your nomadic life.

Myth & Lore 

Face creatures from ancient Asian mythologies, explore enchanted forests glowing with mystical flora, resonating with shamanic rituals, survive cursed groves haunted by spirits, and unlock hidden wisdom through sacred stone totems. Every encounter with a creature is a turning point; some demand combat, others offer cryptic paths through dialogue. You choose your stance: Hunt them. Hear them. Or become something else entirely.

Cultural & Economic Interactions 

Engage with diverse factions across Asia’s vast trade networks. Trade refined goods in bustling border towns, barter with traveling caravans, or negotiate with roaming warbands. Players may form alliances or rivalries with each other, where cooperation can break down into direct PvP combat over territory, resources, and trade dominance.

Seasonal & Environmental Challenges 

Experience a fully dynamic world with shifting seasons and weather extremes. Adapt to summer droughts, harsh winters, and changing wildlife behaviors that impact survival and trade.

name: Nomad: Steppeborn Saga

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD 2.5 GHz or superior
  • Graphics: Direct X 11 or 12 Compatible GPU
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: You can change in-game quality to get maximum performance
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD 2.5 GHz or superior
  • Graphics: NVidia Geforce RTX 2060 or better
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: You can change in-game quality to get maximum performance

short_description: Nomad: Steppeborn Saga is an open world co-op survival crafting adventure set in a vast, ever changing world of nomadic culture. Explore, trade, forge alliances, and face threats while packing up camp, migrating, and forging your legacy.
